V16-057.observed_source_behavior: Bool→on/off, None→none, Str must be an allowed token; all other types are sent to require_enum and rejected, not accepted by fallback.
V16-057.complement_rationale: The delegated fallback is a string-union validator, not a neutral default. Preserve Str allowed/invalid token split and exact wrong-type diagnostics; never route new Value variants to success automatically.

V16-058.observed_source_behavior: Bool true→empty attribute, false→omit, Str must be an allowed token; all other types are sent to require_enum and rejected, not accepted by fallback.
V16-058.complement_rationale: The delegated fallback is a string-union validator, not a neutral default. Preserve Str allowed/invalid token split and exact wrong-type diagnostics; never route new Value variants to success automatically.

V16-061.observed_source_behavior: Only Length with abs>=0 and exact string dot become a DashLength; None from any failed item propagates through collect and the outer native emits its existing dash diagnostic.
V16-061.complement_rationale: Guard-false Length and non-dot Str are actual rejected states, not two nominal successes. Current abs/em/nonfinite behavior must not be silently changed. Refusal is validation, never an omitted dash item or default.

V16-062.observed_source_behavior: Finds first Align/legacy Str and defaults if absent, ignoring body and other non-alignment values.
V16-062.complement_rationale: Content body is deliberately a negative alignment candidate: refusing the whole call on this complement would break omitted alignment. This function is a search projection, not the full public argument validator. Preserve first-match and legacy string conversion.

V16-063.scrutinee: normalized Content when no authoritative snapshot
guard_or_payload_residuals: Source/ShowRecipe/Located/Realized impossible at this normalized match
No direct-schema arm means delegation, not no-op
V16-063.observed_source_behavior: Fallback continues to eval_content_method(fields); it does not erase content or accept a blank result. Success must be Dict, otherwise error. A Some snapshot bypasses reconstruction entirely.
V16-063.complement_rationale: Explicitly implemented legacy field schemas differ from general getter-backed projection. Remaining public elements must continue delegated fields, including Raw/caption presence, without synthesizing defaults. Source/ShowRecipe/Located/Realized are normalized out before this match and cannot be blindly redelegated as public wrappers.

V16-064.observed_source_behavior: Outer fallback sends scalars/empty containers/opaque values to an inner scalar-or-repr match; None is null, Bool/Int/Float preserve exact YAML tokens and opaque values use canonical serialization repr.
V16-064.complement_rationale: Nonempty Array/Dict are guarded; their empty values deliberately enter scalar []/{} branches. Existing Str/Symbol/Content paths cannot reach the inner repr fallback. Flattening must preserve signed zero, nan/inf, newline/quote/indent/error behavior, not apply repr universally.

V16-068.observed_source_behavior: Finds MathAccent through a narrow set of wrappers and first matching sequence child; None causes the calling eval helper to panic on missing target, not report success.
V16-068.complement_rationale: This is a test observation boundary. Unsupported leaves can legitimately lack the target, but Source/realization/new math wrappers may hide it. Do not widen traversal to arbitrary descendants that could find an unrelated target and weaken the oracle. Classify intended fixture wrapper routes first; preserve missing-target failure.
